newsitem.title: USA: Oxford Industries sees record year in 1998.
newsitem.headline: Oxford Industries sees record year in 1998.

text.p: Oxford Industries Inc said it expected progress in its operations to continue and make fiscal 1998 "another record year" after reporting a large profit increase for its fourth quarter.
Oxford had a fourth-quarter profit of $0.59 a share against $0.15 for the same period last year.
The apparel marketing and manufacturing company said in a statement its increased earnings for the period was due to "improved performance" in all its operating groups.

"We expect this year's highly competitive apparel market at wholesale and retail to continue indefinitely," it said in a statement. "However, we believe that we've developed strategies for competing successfully in this environment. We therefore expect to continue our progress and have another record year in fiscal 1998."
